import {ExtremeChaos} from '../chaos/extreme-chaos';
import {FrogChaos} from '../chaos/frog-chaos';

import type {ExtremeChaosState} from '../chaos/extreme-chaos';
import type {FrogChaosState} from '../chaos/frog-chaos';

.chaos-card[data-modifier=gravity_flip]{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#483b85,#7665a4);border-color:#dbd0ff}.chaos-card[data-modifier=pogo_panic]{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#813d73,#a75378);border-color:#ffc6e9}
#chaos-gravity-clock{position:absolute;right:12px;top:48px;z-index:6;pointer-events:none;padding:6px 10px;border:3px solid #d5c7ff;border-radius:10px;background:#2e244de8;color:#f1eaff;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(12px,1.6vw,17px);max-width:60%;box-shadow:0 2px 0 #142f35}#chaos-gravity-clock[hidden]{display:none}#chaos-gravity-clock[data-warning=true]{border-color:#ffe49b;background:#744431f0;color:#fff4c8;animation:gravity-warning .35s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes gravity-warning{to{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #ffe49b55}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#chaos-gravity-clock{animation:none!important}}
